controls.evidence: Finalized slot 453577652: config mint-authority PDA remains BWB53KgBqDZ75rMnEKohR3arDBtPtonppTx2RmjkqQ2r. The complete program census has 20 canonical PermissionRecords, 18 PathwayPolicies, 41 LimitPolicies and five ReserveDestinations, exactly matching config allocation/registration counters; all 89 permission/pathway/limit/destination/asset records reproduce canonical PDA and bump. Fourteen unexpired principal records permit direct mint/redeem; two principal records are expired, four destination-scoped records authorize reserve withdrawal, and no delegated/trilateral executor permission is present. Every pathway is direct and references an existing nonzero flow-limit policy; the three deposit-enabled assets have deposit/redemption rates of 1e9. The canonical legacy-migration PDA is absent, so migration cannot currently mint; source permits future direct governance enablement against a legacy-supply snapshot. Four operational reserve destinations are enabled with per-transaction/daily limits; the treasury destination is disabled. Governance and operations authorities also have built-in reserve-withdrawal access, subject to these destination limits. The deployed executable prefix equals all 1,036,752 published binary bytes (SHA-256 1460e69a8e0330a67d73556e6c7690a1b449d54e7e1c3f3f6ab638768c714830), followed only by zero padding; issuer provenance binds source commit 0dafa95d1aded954de098208f0f515d436aa496c. Current source requires principal collateral transfer before mint but permits governance-approved widening of rates/limits. Reserve withdrawal and program upgrade authority remain separate binding risks; no universally immutable collateral gate, independent financial reconciliation or complete execution-scope certificate is claimed.

review.evidence: The September 15 finalized config/ProgramData and seven Squads observations establish the mint PDA, separated control roles and upgrade path. Live role thresholds supersede the September 4 issuer disclosure. Supplemental K06 review on October 5 at finalized slot 453577652 resolves the former scoped inventory question: all 20 permission, 18 direct-pathway, 41 limit-policy and five reserve-destination records are enumerated, family counters match, and canonical PDA/bump derivations reproduce every record. Fourteen current principal permissions carry direct mint/redeem bits, two principal permissions have expired, and four current destination permissions carry reserve-withdrawal only; no executor or migration permission is registered. All live paths have nonzero limit policies; settlement rates and ceilings can be widened through governance-approved configuration. Legacy migration is uninitialized, not irreversibly disabled: governance retains direct one-shot future activation. Four enabled operational reserve destinations use withdrawal transaction/daily limits; the treasury destination is disabled. Governance and operations roles also retain built-in reserve-withdrawal access under destination limits. Published DEP-00002 executable bytes match pinned ProgramData and published provenance binds the reviewed source commit. Current mint flow limits are governance-raiseable, not immutable bounded or universally collateral-gated; the profile-wide economic-cap review remains unknown. Continuous financial reconciliation, prudential supervision, new-token insurance, complete execution-scope closure and a fresh aggregate incident review are not claimed; the original aggregate review date is intentionally unchanged. Old mint/program, legacy authority and Ceffu reserve evidence remain excluded.
